Distinguish a fixed finite encoder-decoder code problem from an upper certificate over EVERY block length. Fidelity F uses the source fixed-code convention,not a capacity value.

Q(N^tensor k)=kQ(N) gives precision amplification. Compactness gives existence of fixed-dimension uniform cutoffs;effectivity is itself equivalent to the unresolved target.

Fixed-code SDP hierarchy convergence supplies no all-block upper certificate. Half-erasure example F(E4,2)=5/8 andF(E4^tensor2,4)>=17/32>(5/8)^2 refutes the proposed simple fidelity tensorization repair.

The cited2026 source has ordinary-capacity QMA hardness under succinct circuit encoding;its undecidability concerns restricted entanglement-assisted one-shot zero-error CLASSICAL capacity. Different LOCC/catalytic output conventions are not imported into this ordinary protocol.
